decisions.reason: Close to the established offer and with its own page since launch, the option has shown enough value and remains aligned with core digital workflows, so it is kept with low drop probability.
Despite building on training resources, after four years without a dedicated page or strong presence, the option's value is unlikely to be realized, so it is dropped.
As a low-cost support tool that complements the firm's customer support, the option remains cheap to keep and its uncertainty is low, so it is retained.
The analytics dashboard builds on existing data and has a dedicated page, indicating realized value in line with the firm's digital innovation direction, so it is kept.
The bundle is close to the core offer and requires little marginal cost to maintain, and its own page suggests it is an integrated offer, so it is kept with very low drop probability.
As a distant option in a marketplace/portal space with only a mention and no evidence of traction after three years, the uncertainty remains high but the cost and lack of fit justify dropping it.
